start.speaker: Player
start.text: Today is a great day to play.

ID2.speaker: Narrator
ID2.text: You always start the morning with your yarn ball. It's ragged and old, but it's yours and it's precious.

ID3.speaker: Narrator
ID3.text: The sun is barely out, but because you are a fluffy ball of energy and noise, you wake up the whole neighborhood.

ID4.speaker: Narrator
ID4.text: Humans yell at you from their windows, but you don't speak human, so you do not care at all.

ID5.speaker: Narrator
ID5.text: The appearance of a dark cat interrupts your playtime.

ID6.speaker: Narrator
ID6.text: Time seems to have slowed down around you, but you pay it no mind and speak to the stranger.

ID9.speaker: Kronos
ID9.text: I was thinking about the tasty fish behind you...

ID10.speaker: Narrator
ID10.text: At the mention of food, your brain knows no better than your stomach, both empty. You turn around naively all excited for food, but find nothing.

ID12.speaker: Narrator
ID12.text: While you were looking for the promised food, Kronos took the opportunity to steal YOUR yarn ball. He smirks.

ID13.speaker: Player
ID13.text: YOU! How do you have my yarn ball!?

ID14.speaker: Kronos
ID14.text: What matters more than the hows and whats is you getting it back...

ID16.speaker: Kronos
ID16.text: Don't compare me to filthy rats. I'm above them AND you.

ID17.speaker: Kronos
ID17.text: But I'll let it slide this time, for I'm a really generous creature that means no harm.

ID18.speaker: Kronos
ID18.text: Let's make a deal. You see, a week ago I lost my most precious belongins. If you recover them, I'll give you back your yarn ball.

ID19.speaker: Player
ID19.text: If you're so great, why don't you recover them yourself?

ID20.speaker: Kronos
ID20.text: Don't you dare question me, peasant. Just win three games for me, get my dear artifacts back, and you'll get your ball.

ID22.speaker: Kronos
ID22.text: I don't play with brats. Your opponents will be my... ehem, friends.

ID24.speaker: Narrator
ID24.text: You sigh and glance at the yarn ball Kronos is fiddling with.

ID26.speaker: Narrator
ID26.text:
You seal the deal with a paw-shake. A blue glow surrounds you for a few seconds before disappearing. 
Kronos gestures to the box behind him.

ID28.speaker: Narrator
ID28.text: You're confused, but you refrain from arguing. The faster you get your yarn ball back, the better.

ID29.speaker: Narrator
ID29.text: The box is bigger inside than you thought.

end.speaker: Kronos
end.text: This is how we'll travel. And because I'm such a benevolent god, I'll let you choose our first destination.
